integrity: Analytical proof plus exact rational computation on a finite test grid; finite computations do not certify the continuum theorem.
scientific_limitations: Optimality concerns couplings of two uniform Rademacher probe vectors in dimensions at most three; high-dimensional couplings and setup complexity are not analyzed. The exact 31-fold reduction is for the specified trace difference, not for each marginal. Classical rearrangement theorem is prior art. Independent validation remains outstanding.
title: The dimension-three boundary for optimal shared-sign trace probes
